issue.body:
Steps to reproduce the issue:
1. Start ZAP;
2. Deselect the option "Options" > "Display" > "Show Main Toolbar" (and restart ZAP, if using older versions);
3. Note that it's no longer possible to enabled/disable Forced User mode, the option is/was only available in the main tool bar.

Remarks:
It's still possible to enable/disable it using the ZAP API.

ZAP Versions:
Versions >= 2.4.0

issue.body:
This is a core dev pickup of #2837 which has been abandon and we've been unable to get in-touch with the original submitter (@rajiv65).

Edit menu now has an option to change ZAP mode. Mode can now be changed even if the main toolbar is hidden.

Fixes zaproxy/zaproxy#2375
